persons.name: Rāma
persons.evidence: maya(!) rāma iti santo viṣṇuvyākhyānam ālikhet

relations.evidence: rājye tasya mahodaye janapade bhaktāpurīpaṭṭane || ... maya(!) rāma iti santo viṣṇuvyākhyānam ālikhet

date.as_written: eke haskaravāhanendriyavidhe nepālasamvatsare māse kārttikaśuklaviśvatithiśe(?) bhe(?) pūrvvabhadrāhvaye | vāre bhāskarisaṃgame

notes: The chronogram 'eke (1) haskaravāhana (7) indriya (5)' gives NS 571. 'viśva' corresponds to tithi 13. 'bhāskari' refers to Saturn (Saturday). The scribe's name may be Rāma (taking 'maya(!)' as an error for 'mayā', 'by me, [called] Rāma') or Mayārāma. An unnamed brāhmaṇa performing the vrata is mentioned ('dvijavarakuladharmmī...').
